SvidList.Name: ControlState
SvidList.Description: Current control state of the equipment (1 - Equipment Offline, 2 - Attempt Online, 3 - Host Offline, 4 - Online Local, 5 - Online Remote)

SvidList.Name: PreviousControlState
SvidList.Description: Previous control state of the equipment (1 - Equipment Offline, 2 - Attempt Online, 3 - Host Offline, 4 - Online Local, 5 - Online Remote)

SvidList.Name: EventsEnabled
SvidList.Description: List of events currently enabled for reporting

SvidList.Name: LastEventID
SvidList.Description: ID of the last triggered collection event

SvidList.Name: Clock
SvidList.Description: Value of the equipments internal clock

SvidList.Name: AlarmsEnabled
SvidList.Description: List of alarms currently enabled for reporting

SvidList.Name: AlarmsSet
SvidList.Description: List of alarms currently set

SvidList.Name: SpoolCountActual
SvidList.Description: Count of the messages currently contained in the spool buffer

SvidList.Name: SpoolCountTotal
SvidList.Description: Count of the messages spooled in total

SvidList.Name: SpoolStartTime
SvidList.Description: Contains the timestamp spool became active last time

SvidList.Name: SpoolFullTime
SvidList.Description: Contains the timestamp the spool buffer became full last time

SvidList.Name: PPError
SvidList.Description: A text data value with information about verification errors of a process program that failed verification.

SvidList.Name: ProcessState
SvidList.Description: E30 process state value (0 - None, 1 - Init, 2 - Idle, 3 - Setup, 4 - Ready, 5 - Executing, 6 - Pause, 7 - Error)

SvidList.Name: PreviousProcessState
SvidList.Description: Previous E30 process state value (0 - None, 1 - Init, 2 - Idle, 3 - Setup, 4 - Ready, 5 - Executing, 6 - Pause)
